description: This PHP class 'ConsoleProjectListener' handles various project-related events in the Goteo crowdfunding platform, such as project failure, success, passing multiple rounds, and related logging and notifications.

classes.name: ConsoleProjectListener
classes.description: This class listens to project lifecycle events (such as failure, success, and round passing) and performs logging, notifications, and feed updates accordingly.

methods.name: logFeedEntry
methods.description: Logs a feed entry, warning if it's a duplicate, otherwise notices it.

methods.name: onProjectFailed
methods.description: Handles the event when a project fails, archives it, logs the event, updates feeds, and sends notifications.

methods.name: onProjectOneRound
methods.description: Handles the event when a project completes its first (and only) funding round successfully, updates feeds, and sends notifications.

methods.name: onProjectRound1
methods.description: Handles the event when a two-round project passes the first round, updates feeds, and notifies users.

methods.name: onProjectRound2
methods.description: Handles the event when a two-round project passes the second round, finalizes funding, updates feeds, and notifies users.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping event constants to handler methods for event subscription.
